description: Pinned, reproducible build toolchain for the Windows-compatible shape. The SLeeLa OS Creator resolves this manifest to provision a hermetic environment and then invokes windows/build-shape.sh to compile a chosen path into a bootable/installable artifact. Linux host; no Microsoft source, SDK, or license is used.

hostBase.rationale: Matches the Ubuntu 24.04.4 base rootfs assembled under linux/os-loader, so the Windows shape builds against the same userland the OS Creator ships.

requires.notes: gcc-multilib/g++-multilib enable WoW64 (64-bit Wine that also runs 32-bit apps) via ./configure --enable-archs=i386,x86_64. For 64-bit-only, ./configure --enable-win64.

rosArch.notes: reactos/reactos/configure.sh fails closed unless ROS_ARCH is set. On a Linux host RosBE is NOT required: the real need is a MinGW-w64 cross toolchain (set above), plus CMake, Ninja, flex and bison. setup-debian.sh installs these and exports ROS_ARCH.

requires.notes: ReactOS uses toolchain-gcc.cmake with the MinGW-w64 prefix matching ARCH. Installs onto a FAT16/FAT32 active partition. Minimum ~15 GB free disk recommended for a full build.

orchestrator.emits: A declared artifact per path (see paths[*].artifact): wine -> an installed Wine prefix; reactos -> bootcd.iso.
